newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-St George sees A$25 mln savings.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-St George sees A$25 mln savings.

text.p: St George Bank Ltd said on Tuesday it would save an estimated A$25 million annually by consolidating retail and business banking technology systems among its various divisions, including Advance Bank and BankSA.

"St George Bank will consolidate all of the group's core retail and business banking business or to a single set of core systems, yielding an expected saving of A$25 million a year," the regional bank said in a statement.

"The decision was made following extensive studies by an information technology integration team of all systems options open to St George, Advance and BankSA, and its unanimous recommendation to the St George board," it said.
Most of the integration was expected to be completed within 18 months.

"Apart from the A$25 million a year savings in direct IT costs, systems integration is the key to unlocking many other substantial cost savings, such as facilitating the merger of back offices: facilitating the provision of a Group-wide set of products; and enabling branch rationalisation with little or no impact on customers," the bank said.
The merger with Advance Bank Australia Ltd was completed in January, with St George saying it expected savings of about A$140 million from the cost-savings.
